topic: Important International Boundary Lines (महत्वपूर्ण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा रेखाएं)
description: This topic deals with the major political and geographical boundary lines (राजनीतिक और भौगोलिक सीमा रेखाएं) between various countries of the world. It is a highly crucial topic under Static GK (स्टेटिक जीके) for competitive examinations.

sections.title: Major International Boundary Lines of India (भारत की प्रमुख अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा रेखाएं)
sections.description: Historical and strategic boundary lines dividing India and its neighboring countries (पड़ोसी देश).

key_associations.extra_info: Demarcated by Sir Cyril Radcliffe in 1947. It also serves as the border between India and Bangladesh (भारत और बांग्लादेश), which was formerly East Pakistan.
Drawn by Sir Henry McMahon under the 1914 Shimla Agreement (शिमला समझौता). It primarily covers the border in Arunachal Pradesh (अरुणाचल प्रदेश).
Demarcated by Sir Mortimer Durand in 1893. A small segment of 106 km exists between India (PoK region) and Afghanistan (भारत और अफगानिस्तान).
The ceasefire line (युद्धविराम रेखा) in Jammu & Kashmir, which was officially renamed after the 1972 Simla Agreement (शिमला समझौता).

key_associations.item: Line of Actual Control - LAC (वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा)
key_associations.extra_info: The boundary separating Indian-controlled territory from Chinese-controlled territory, particularly in the Aksai Chin region (अक्साई चिन क्षेत्र).

sections.title: Major Boundary Lines of Europe (यूरोप की प्रमुख सीमा रेखाएं)
sections.description: Crucial boundary lines drawn between European countries during or after World War I (प्रथम विश्व युद्ध) and World War II (द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध).

key_associations.extra_info: A highly fortified defensive line (रक्षा पंक्ति) built by France after WWI to prevent a German invasion.
A defensive line built by Germany parallel to the Maginot Line. It is also known as the 'Westwall' (वेस्टवॉल).
Germany's defensive line during WWI. The German army retreated from this line in 1918.
A defensive line built by Finland against the Soviet Union (सोवियत संघ) during the Winter War (शीतकालीन युद्ध).
The border decided at the Potsdam Conference (पॉट्सडैम सम्मेलन) after WWII, running along the Oder and Neisse rivers.

sections.title: Major Latitude Boundary Lines of the World (विश्व की प्रमुख अक्षांश सीमा रेखाएं)
sections.description: Major international borders of the world based on latitudes or parallels (अक्षांश रेखाएं).

key_associations.associated_with: North Korea and South Korea (उत्तर कोरिया और दक्षिण कोरिया)
key_associations.extra_info: The line dividing the Korean Peninsula (कोरियाई प्रायद्वीप) at the end of WWII.

key_associations.associated_with: USA and Canada (संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और कनाडा)
key_associations.extra_info: It forms the longest unfortified border in the world (दुनिया की सबसे लंबी अकिलेबंद सीमा).

key_associations.associated_with: North Vietnam and South Vietnam (उत्तरी वियतनाम और दक्षिणी वियतनाम)
key_associations.extra_info: The boundary before the unification of Vietnam (वियतनाम का एकीकरण) in 1976, established as per the 1954 Geneva Accords (जिनेवा समझौते).
Located in the Rann of Kutch (कच्छ का रण). Pakistan claims this as the boundary, but India outrightly rejects (अस्वीकार) it.

sections.title: Historical Boundary Agreements (ऐतिहासिक सीमा समझौते)
sections.description: Major historical years and events associated with the border demarcation of India.

historical_events.event: Signing of Durand Agreement (डूरंड समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर)
historical_events.significance: Established the Durand Line between British India (ब्रिटिश भारत) and the Afghan Amir Abdur Rahman Khan.
The McMahon Line was recognized as the official India-Tibet border between Tibet (तिब्बत) and Great Britain.
The Boundary Commission (सीमा आयोग) officially announced the Radcliffe Line for the partition of India (भारत का विभाजन).

sections.title: Important Facts Related to Borders (सीमाओं से जुड़े महत्वपूर्ण तथ्य)
sections.description: Extremely important one-liner facts (वन-लाइनर तथ्य) regarding international borders for quick revision.

important_facts.fact: India shares its longest international border (सबसे लंबी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा) with Bangladesh (बांग्लादेश), measuring 4,096.7 kilometers.
India shares its shortest international border (सबसे छोटी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा) with Afghanistan (अफगानिस्तान), which is only 106 kilometers long in the PoK region.
The border between the USA and Canada is the longest international land border in the world (दुनिया की सबसे लंबी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय भूमि सीमा).
The Palk Strait (पाक जलडमरूमध्य) is the water boundary (जल सीमा) that separates India and Sri Lanka (भारत और श्रीलंका).
